reasons: Verified product facts support this first-email scope: Start a 14-day trial with no credit card, prompt Balsamiq AI (or drop in a screenshot) to produce a wireframe of one proposed flow, make it interactive without code inside a single project, and invite stakeholders as reviewers who can view or comment at no extra cost.
recommendation.eligible_subsegment: Start a 14-day trial with no credit card, prompt Balsamiq AI (or drop in a screenshot) to produce a wireframe of one proposed flow, make it interactive without code inside a single project, and invite stakeholders as reviewers who can view or comment at no extra cost.
allowed_claims: Balsamiq lets users go from rough wireframe to interactive prototype without writing a single line of code
Balsamiq AI can take a prompt or a dropped-in screenshot and generate something interactive instantly
Balsamiq boards can be read, edited, and built on with Claude, Cursor, and other tools via an MCP server
Wireframes can be exported/shared to Notion, Jira, Slack, Claude, and Linear
A quote PDF for Balsamiq Cloud includes a quote number, company details, and prices honored for 60 days, and can serve as a signable order form
Balsamiq accepts card payments directly, but invoices and payment terms require buying through a reseller
Balsamiq Starter plan costs $16/month per editor, billed annually at $192/year
Balsamiq Teams plan costs $24/month per editor, billed annually at $288/year
Balsamiq Enterprise plan costs $35/month per editor, billed annually at $420/year
Starter plan includes up to 10 projects and 500 monthly Balsamiq AI credits per editor, enough for around 31 wireframes or 10 prototypes
Teams plan includes up to 100 projects and 1,000 monthly Balsamiq AI credits per editor, enough for around 62 wireframes or 20 prototypes
Enterprise plan includes up to 400 projects and 2,500 monthly Balsamiq AI credits per editor, enough for around 156 wireframes or 50 prototypes
On-demand AI credit top-ups cost $15 per 500 credits on all plans
Enterprise plan adds SSO with SAML, legal and security review support, and project file storage in the US or EU
Balsamiq offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card required
Registered nonprofits get 50% off the first year of an annual Starter or Teams plan
A project is a folder for a specific initiative containing unlimited free boards, and customers pay per project, not per board
Balsamiq AI credits can be used to create and edit wireframes, convert screenshots to wireframes, generate images, and generate interactive prototypes
